_comment: TASK-015 (RFC 8601 section 5): an Authentication-Results field counts only when its authserv-id is the RECEIVING provider's own. One entry per provider class the deliverability record uses: its authservIds, and the hostSuffixes its own MTAs are named under (the accepting hop and every hop above it must be `by` one of them). The university mailbox's authserv-id identifies the institution and is therefore never committed: pass it at run time with --authserv-id (check-received.mjs), and record only its class in records.json. Add a provider only with the authserv-id MEASURED from a delivered message's headers, never from memory.

espMarkers._comment: Third-party mail-API relays. A marker in any Received hop, header name or DKIM d= fails the check: the vendor's mail is sent by its own Stalwart (PRD-REC-006).
